visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A static close-up shot focuses on a digital menu board inside a McDonald's, displaying various limited-edition items like chocolate pies, spicy nuggets, and burgers. The screen is illuminated with bright, flat studio-style lighting, and Japanese text and pricing are visible next to vibrant food photography. (2) A quick cut shows a hand holding a paper receipt with '1,870￥' and 'PayPay' printed clearly. The background is a blurry indoor setting with neutral lighting. (3) A medium shot features a female creator with long dark hair, wearing a red cap and a grey sweatshirt, smiling as a staff member hands her a food tray. The background shows a busy restaurant interior with colorful wall decorations. (4) A top-down shot presents a tray filled with McDonald's food: two pie boxes, a nugget box, fries, a burger, and a large drink. The objects are arranged neatly on a green tray liner with festive illustrations. (5) The creator holds a single, dark-speckled spicy nugget close to the camera, then takes a bite, showing her facial expressions of concentration and then a satisfied nod. The background is a slightly out-of-focus restaurant seating area. (6) Close-up shots of two dipping sauce containers being opened by hands; the sauces are dark brown (garlic) and creamy white (cheese). The creator dips a fry and a nugget into the sauces, reacting with wide eyes and a smile. (7) The creator shows the 'Nama Chocolate' pie packaging and then bites into the crispy, dark brown pie. She chews thoroughly, looking upwards as if evaluating the flavor. (8) A similar sequence follows for the 'White Chocolate Milk Tea' pie, which has a golden-brown crust and a creamy filling. The creator exhibits high energy and pleasure through her squinted eyes and facial movements. (9) The creator bites into a large burger containing a hash brown and beef patties, taking a massive bite that fills her mouth. Her expression shifts to one of slight surprise or intensity as she reacts to the saltiness. (10) A final summary montage briefly repeats close-ups of the nuggets and the chocolate pie against the restaurant background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop music begins, featuring a driving synthesized beat and bright melodic textures. A female voice speaks in high-arousal Mandarin, enthusiastically introducing the new McDonald's items. The background contains a faint, muffled hum of a public restaurant. (2) A sharp, short digital UI 'click' or chime triggers as the scene shifts to the receipt, while the music continues at a consistent volume. The speaker's tone remains friendly and casual as she discusses the price. (3) A brief interaction occurs where a second female voice is heard saying 'Arigatou gozaimasu' with a polite, professional Japanese intonation. The main speaker responds with increased excitement and slightly higher pitch as she receives the food tray. (4) Distinct percussive 'crunch' sound effects occur when the creator bites into the nuggets and pies, characterized by high-frequency transients. The music maintains a steady 4/4 rhythm underneath the descriptive narration about the spicy black pepper flavors. (5) Audible plastic rustling and peeling sounds occur as dipping sauce containers are opened, followed by a vocal tone shift indicating curiosity and then approval. The music swells slightly during transitions between different food items. (6) The speaker's delivery becomes more exaggerated and humorous, with noticeable vocal strain and high-arousal shouting when describing the saltiness of the burger, contrasting with the previous joyful tone. The BGM fades out sharply at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide an energetic and authentic review of McDonald's Japan's new limited-time menu items, including snacks and desserts. The creator shares her genuine reactions to flavors, textures, and value for money to inform and entertain food-loving viewers.
